HUD builds infrastructure for AI data, including a marketplace and platform used to create and evaluate AI environments and training data. The Design Engineer will design and build interfaces across HUD’s products, making agent runs, evaluation results, reward signals, and quality feedback understandable and actionable while collaborating with users, researchers, and engineers.

Responsibilities
Design and build interfaces across HUD’s platform and marketplace, from early concepts through shipped product
Make agent runs, evaluation results, reward signals, and quality feedback understandable and actionable
Work with research and engineering to turn complex RL and evaluation workflows into useful tools
Talk with users, observe where they struggle, and use what you learn to improve the product
Develop thoughtful interaction patterns and maintain a high bar for usability, visual quality, and implementation

Required
Strong product and interaction design judgment, especially for complex tools or workflows
Front-end engineering skills and the ability to turn your designs into working product interfaces
A record of shipping products, learning from users, and improving what you built
The ability to understand technical concepts well enough to present them clearly to users
Good judgment about when to ship quickly and when an experience needs more care
Clear communication and comfort working closely with engineers, researchers, and users
Preferred
Experience designing developer tools, data-rich products, or research software
Familiarity with AI agents, evaluations, reinforcement learning, or training data
Experience creating reusable interface patterns as a product grows
Experience working independently in an early-stage company

Support for relocation and visas for strong full-time candidates to the US or Singapore
